description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'DataGroupDao' responsible for database operations related to data groups and permissions in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving data groups, permissions, and API permissions, using query builders and entity relationships.

classes.name: DataGroupDao
classes.description: A DAO class extending BaseDao for performing CRUD operations and complex queries related to DataGroup and DataGroupPermission entities, including permission filtering and retrieval based on role and API data.

methods.name: getDataGroup
methods.description: Fetches a DataGroup entity by its name.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Retrieves DataGroupPermission entities based on role ID, data group names, and self permission flag.

methods.name: getApiPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves API-specific DataGroupPermission entities for given roles and API class name.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Fetches DataGroupPermission entities based on filtering parameters encapsulated in DataGroupPermissionFilterParams object.

methods.name: getDataGroups
methods.description: Fetches all DataGroup entities ordered by description.
